basic_details.job_title: BFUHS Project Staff Nurse II (Pediatrics) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One Project Staff Nurse II post in the Department of Pediatrics at Guru Gobind Singh Medical College and Hospital, Faridkot, is to be filled on a purely temporary/contract basis under the ICMR, New Delhi funded project "Development of an Early Warning System for Detection of Neonatal Sepsis using Artificial Intelligence for hospital settings". The pay is Rs 23,100 per month including HRA, for a tenure up to 28 February 2027, and the essential qualification is GNM (General Nursing Midwifery). content_sections.heading: About the University and the Project
content_sections.text: Baba Farid University of Health Sciences is at Sadiq Road, Faridkot, Punjab, and the post sits at its associated Guru Gobind Singh Medical College and Hospital. The post is part of the ICMR-funded project on an early warning system for detecting neonatal sepsis using artificial intelligence in hospital settings. The notice calls these posts purely temporary and part of that project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice states that an applicant must possess the requisite qualification and experience at the time of interview. The application form asks for registration details with a Central/State Medical/Nursing Council, whether the applicant knows Punjabi up to Matric standard (Y/N), and carries a declaration that the applicant is an Indian National. Candidates already in service need the present employer's no-objection certificate on the form. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.requirement: For SC/OBC category as per the Punjab Govt. Rules

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The total pay is Rs 23,100 per month, made up of Rs 21,000 plus 10% HRA of Rs 2,100 per month. The tenure is a maximum up to 28 February 2027. The notice says the post would be abolished if the project ends early for any reason. Half month of the selected candidate's salary is deposited as security with BFUHS for the first two months of appointment. This security is forfeited if the candidate leaves after joining without serving one month notice to the undersigned office. The employer may also end the service after giving one month notice, and the selected candidate may leave after giving one month notice.

content_sections.heading: BFUHS Project Staff Nurse II Job Description
content_sections.text: Rotational duties including night shift in the Department of Pediatrics, with only four offs per month.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BFUHS Project Staff Nurse II
content_sections.text: Use the prescribed application proforma printed in the notice (titled "Application form" on Baba Farid University of Health Sciences, Faridkot letterhead). Pay the non-refundable fee to The Registrar, Baba Farid University of Health Sciences, Faridkot, payable at Faridkot; the form has a field for DD No., date and amount. Attach self-attested copies of certificates for proof of date of birth, permanent residence, marks sheet, degree, experience etc. Send the completed application form with fee and self-attested documents to the Principal Office, Guru Gobind Singh Medical College, by 20 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Attend the interview on 23 November 2026 at 10:00 AM at Guru Gobind Singh Medical College and Hospital, Faridkot. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice states that the interview will be held on 23 November 2026 at 10:00 AM and that a written test will also be conducted as part of the recruitment selection process. The notice does not give the written test pattern or syllabus.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in BFUHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 (ONE) post of Project Staff Nurse II at Guru Gobind Singh Medical College and Hospital, Faridkot.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BFUHS Project Staff Nurse II?
faq.answer: The application form with fee and self-attested documents is to be sent to the Principal Office, Guru Gobind Singh Medical College, by 20 November 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for BFUHS Project Staff Nurse II?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is GNM (General Nursing Midwifery). Neonatal and/or Pediatric Nursing experience is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years as on 23/11/2026. Age relaxation is given to the SC/OBC category as per the Punjab Govt. Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Project Staff Nurse II?
faq.answer: The total pay is Rs 23,100 per month, made up of Rs 21,000 plus 10% HRA of Rs 2,100.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs 23,100?
faq.answer: The notice prints Rs 23,100 as the total including HRA (Rs 21,000 + 10% HRA = Rs 2,100 per month). It names no further allowance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: General Category pays Rs. 1770 (Rs. 1500 + GST Rs. 270) and SC Category pays Rs. 885 (Rs. 750 + GST Rs. 135). The fee is non-refundable and payable to The Registrar, BFUHS, at Faridkot.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Complete the prescribed application form, attach self-attested documents and the fee, and send them to the Principal Office, Guru Gobind Singh Medical College, by 20 November 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The interview is on 23 November 2026 at 10:00 AM, and a written test will also be conducted as part of the selection process.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is strictly temporary/contract, up to 28 February 2027 at most, and ends earlier if the project ends. Either side may end the service on one month notice.
